obligation: Condition affecting safety of project works: initial report
trigger: Discovery of a security incident (physical and/or cyber) or of any misoperation of a gate or other facility that controls the release of impounded water
deadline: As soon as practicable after the condition is discovered, preferably within 72 hours, without unduly interfering with emergency action
notify: FERC Regional Engineer by email or telephone
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - FERC licensee; the Plant Superintendent reports (Owner if unavailable)

obligation: Condition affecting safety of project works: written report
trigger: After the initial report
deadline: Within the time the Regional Engineer specifies; verified under 12.13; causes, preceding events, measures taken, damage, injuries, and property damage
applies_at_this_tier: Yes

obligation: Deaths, serious injuries, or rescues at the project
trigger: Any drowning or other death, serious injury, or rescue at the project works or involving project operation (for example, recreation users caught by a sudden release from an unauthorized gate opening)
deadline: Initial report promptly after discovery; written report for project-related events
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if any occur

obligation: Security incident or suspicious activity report to FERC
citation: FERC Security Program for Hydropower Projects Rev. 3A, sec. 3.2 and 4.2
trigger: Suspicious activity or a security incident at the project, unless law enforcement restricts reporting
deadline: As soon as practical (usually within one working day)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - all licensees including Group 3; can be the same call as the 12.10 initial report

obligation: Suspicious activity report to the HSIN Dams portal
citation: FERC Security Program Rev. 3A, sec. 4.2 and footnote 1
trigger: Suspicious activity or incident, regardless of apparent significance
deadline: No deadline stated; report promptly
notify: DHS Homeland Security Information Network (HSIN) suspicious activity tool
applies_at_this_tier: Voluntary but highly recommended; HSIN account requested by 2026-11-30 (P03 G-021)

obligation: Local law enforcement and emergency management
citation: FERC Security Program Rev. 3A, sec. 3.3.3 and 4.2; project EAP contact list
trigger: Serious security incident, including any unauthorized control of gates or units
deadline: Immediately, in parallel: the sheriff to deal with the intruder; county emergency management if people downstream may be at risk
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - company procedure (POL-03 4.6)

obligation: Emergency Action Plan notifications
trigger: Impending or actual sudden release of water (project emergency)
deadline: Per the EAP notification flowchart (immediate)
notify: County emergency management and the agencies and downstream parties listed in the EAP
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if the event becomes a project emergency

obligation: Other dam owners in the drainage basin
trigger: Security situation that could affect other dam owners
deadline: As quickly as possible
notify: County public works (operator of the low-head weir 6 miles downstream)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes

obligation: Temporary closure of recreation facilities for security
trigger: Closing the canoe launch, portage trail, or bank-fishing area for security reasons for 30 days or less
deadline: Notify as soon as practical (usually within one working day); closures over 30 days need prior coordination
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if recreation facilities are closed

obligation: Voluntary cyber incident report to the FBI and CISA
trigger: Suspected cyber intrusion into the control system
deadline: As soon as possible; no regulatory deadline
notify: FBI field office (or IC3) and CISA
applies_at_this_tier: Voluntary; strongly advised. Timely reporting is a mitigating factor under the OFAC advisory

obligation: NERC CIP-008-6 R4 Reportable Cyber Security Incident notification
trigger: Reportable Cyber Security Incident on high or medium impact BES Cyber Systems
deadline: Within 1 hour after determination; attempts by end of next calendar day
applies_at_this_tier: No - 4.4 MW at 12.47 kV is not a BES facility and the company is not NERC-registered (P03 G-056)

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident report / ransom payment report (PROPOSED - not yet in effect)
trigger: Covered cyber incident or ransom payment
deadline: Proposed: 72 hours; 24 hours after ransom payment
applies_at_this_tier: No - final rule not published as of 2026-09-25; no dams-specific criterion and the company is far below the SBA size standard used in the proposed scope; recheck when final

obligation: Florida breach notice to individuals
trigger: Breach of security of personal information of Florida residents (for example, employee records in the suite or the payroll service)
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach
applies_at_this_tier: Only if personal information is involved; not expected for an OT-only intrusion

obligation: Florida notice to the Department of Legal Affairs
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more individuals in Florida
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach
applies_at_this_tier: Not expected - the company holds personal information for 7 employees and a small number of former employees

obligation: Florida notice to consumer reporting agencies
trigger: Notice required to more than 1,000 individuals at one time
deadline: Without unreasonable delay
applies_at_this_tier: Not expected - far fewer than 1,000 individuals

obligation: Third-party agent notice to the company
trigger: A third-party agent holding company personal information (the payroll service or the MSP) has a breach
deadline: Within 10 days
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - the company must then decide on notices; ask for this in contracts (POL-02 A.5)

obligation: State data breach notification (other states)
citation: State breach notification statutes (all 50 states, DC, PR, USVI; Guam 9 GCA Ch. 48)
trigger: Breach of computerized personal information of residents of other states
deadline: Varies by state
notify: Affected residents; state regulators where required
applies_at_this_tier: Only if a current or former employee lives outside Florida

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom payment
citation: OFAC Updated Advisory on Potential Sanctions Risks for Facilitating Ransomware Payments (Sept. 21, 2021); 31 CFR ch. V
trigger: Considering a ransom payment
deadline: Before any payment; full and timely reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if sanctioned party); FBI or CISA
applies_at_this_tier: All U.S. persons

obligation: Covered telecommunications equipment or services discovered
trigger: Contractor identifies covered telecommunications equipment or services in use or delivered
deadline: Within 1 business day of identification (further report within 10 business days)
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company holds no federal contracts or subcontracts

obligation: Kaspersky covered article discovered
trigger: Contractor identifies a covered article (Kaspersky Lab hardware, software, or services) in use or delivered
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification (further report within 10 business days)
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company holds no federal contracts or subcontracts

obligation: Cooperative (offtaker) notice
trigger: Event affecting output or a planned or forced outage of the units
deadline: Per contract (call the cooperative at once for any forced outage)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual

obligation: Cyber insurance claim notice
trigger: Suspected security incident
deadline: Per policy (use the carrier's 24x7 breach hotline before hiring any outside firm)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual
